# Ouro

> Self-hosted Luau 0.748 parser, bytecode compiler, and sandboxed register VM in pure Luau.

This file indexes the project for coding agents reading a local copy of it, in the llms.txt format: its guides, then every module, type, and member its Luau source exposes. Links are relative to this file, and each API entry links the lines that declare it, directly below its doc comment.

Keep it current: after changing the public surface, a doc comment, or a guide, run `npx luaudocs@0.3.0 llms` in this directory and commit the result. When nothing listed here changed, the command leaves the file as it is.

## Guides

- [Overview](.luaudocs/guide/introduction/index.md): An introduction to Ouro, a self-hosted Luau 0.748 parser, compiler, and register VM in pure Luau.
- [Getting Started](.luaudocs/guide/introduction/getting-started.md): Install Ouro with Wally, pesde, Rojo, or GitHub Releases and run your first script.
- [Parsing & AST](.luaudocs/guide/pipeline/parsing.md): Parse Luau source into flat numeric arenas with lossless byte preservation and yielding checkpoints.
- [Compiling & Bytecode](.luaudocs/guide/pipeline/compiling.md): Lower ASTs to O0–O2 Luau bytecode and inspect, verify, serialize, or decode bytecode payloads.
- [Sandboxed VM](.luaudocs/guide/pipeline/vm.md): Execute source or binary Luau bytecode in isolated environments with execution budgets and hooks.
- [Benchmarks](.luaudocs/guide/benchmarks.md): Comparing Ouro against Fiu and LuauCeption across VM execution, O2 compilation, cold startup, and code size.

- [`Ouro.upstreamRevision`](src/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Pinned upstream Luau Git commit SHA from `UPSTREAM.json`.
- [`Ouro.Ast: Ast`](src/Ast.luau): [Module] Lossless AST table serializer (`Ast.toTables`).

- [`Ouro.Tokens: Token`](src/Token.luau): [Module] Immutable map of token names (`Eof`, `Name`, `ReservedFunction`, ...) to numeric token kinds.

## Ouro.Ast

- [Ast](src/Ast.luau): Optional lossless AST table serialization for arena-backed `ParseResult` values.
- [`type AstTable = Types.AstTable`](src/Ast.luau#L9)
- [`Ast.toTables(result: Types.ParseResult): AstTable?`](src/Ast.luau#L242-L264): Materializes an arena-backed `ParseResult` into lossless AST tables with numeric byte spans.

## Ouro.Bytecode

- [Bytecode](src/Bytecode.luau): Bytecode codec, disassembler, verifier, opcode tables, and instruction helpers for Luau `v3`–`v14` bytecode.
- [`type BytecodeDecoder = Types.BytecodeDecoder`](src/Bytecode.luau#L9)
- [`type ProtoModule = Types.ProtoModule`](src/Bytecode.luau#L12)
- [`Bytecode.disassemble`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Disassembles binary Luau bytecode or a `ProtoModule` into human-readable listings, throwing on corrupt input.
- [`Bytecode.deserialize`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Decodes binary Luau bytecode (`v3`–`v14` and `v100`) into an immutable `ProtoModule`.
- [`Bytecode.serialize`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Encodes a `ProtoModule` back into binary Luau bytecode with an optional opcode encoder.
- [`Bytecode.decodeLineInfo`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Unpacks delta-encoded line numbers and per-proto baseline offsets for a `Proto`.
- [`Bytecode.encodeError`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Formats a compiler or parser error message as a status-zero binary bytecode payload.
- [`Bytecode.decodeError`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Extracts the error message from a status-zero bytecode payload, or `nil` for valid bytecode.
- [`Bytecode.getStringHash`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Computes the Luau bytecode string hash for an identifier or string constant.
- [`Bytecode.getImportId`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Packs 1 to 3 string constant indices into a 32-bit `LOP_GETIMPORT` identifier.
- [`Bytecode.decomposeImportId`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Unpacks a 32-bit `LOP_GETIMPORT` identifier into `(count, id0, id1, id2)`.
- [`Bytecode.insnOp`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Extracts the opcode byte (`0..255`) from a 32-bit bytecode instruction word.
- [`Bytecode.insnA`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Extracts operand A (`8`-bit unsigned) from a 32-bit bytecode instruction word.
- [`Bytecode.insnB`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Extracts operand B (`8`-bit unsigned) from a 32-bit bytecode instruction word.
- [`Bytecode.insnC`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Extracts operand C (`8`-bit unsigned) from a 32-bit bytecode instruction word.
- [`Bytecode.insnD`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Extracts signed 16-bit operand D from a 32-bit bytecode instruction word.
- [`Bytecode.insnE`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Extracts signed 24-bit operand E from a 32-bit bytecode instruction word.
- [`Bytecode.Opcodes`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Map of upstream `LOP_*` instruction names to numeric opcodes.
- [`Bytecode.opcodeNames`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Reverse lookup table from numeric opcode to instruction name.
- [`Bytecode.opLengths`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Instruction word length (`1` or `2`) keyed by numeric opcode.
- [`Bytecode.Builtins`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Map of upstream `LBF_*` fastcall builtin names to numeric IDs.
- [`Bytecode.builtinNames`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Reverse lookup table from numeric builtin ID to function name.
- [`Bytecode.Tags`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Bytecode format version limits and constant/type tag constants (`LBC_*`).
- [`Bytecode.Types`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Encoded bytecode type tags (`LBC_TYPE_*`).
- [`Bytecode.Captures`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Upvalue capture mode tags (`LCT_*`).
- [`Bytecode.ProtoFlags`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Function prototype flag bitmasks (`LPF_*`).
- [`Bytecode.FeedbackTypes`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Inline feedback entry type tags (`LFT_*`).
- [`Bytecode.DumpFlags`](src/Bytecode.luau#L1): [Re-export] Bitmask flags controlling `disassemble` and compiler dump output.
- [`Bytecode.verify(input: string | buffer | ProtoModule, decoder: BytecodeDecoder?): (boolean, string?)`](src/Bytecode.luau#L37): Validates binary bytecode or a `ProtoModule` statically without instantiating a closure.

## Ouro.Compiler

- [Compiler](src/Compiler.luau): Bytecode compiler lowering Ouro `ParseResult` arenas or Luau source strings across optimization levels `0`–`2`.
- [`type CompileConstant = PublicTypes.CompileConstant`](src/Compiler.luau#L147)
- [`type CompileOptions = PublicTypes.CompileOptions`](src/Compiler.luau#L148)
- [`type CompileResult = PublicTypes.CompileResult`](src/Compiler.luau#L149)
- [`Compiler.CompilerFlags`](src/Compiler.luau#L1): [Re-export] Default Luau 0.748 compiler flags, overridable per call through `CompileOptions.flags`.
- [`Compiler.compile(sourceOrParseResult: string | PublicTypes.ParseResult, compileOpts: CompileOptions?): (string?, string?)`](src/Compiler.luau#L4245): Compiles Luau source code or a parsed AST into a serialized bytecode string, returning `(bytecode, nil)` or `(nil, err)`.
- [`Compiler.compileResult(sourceOrParseResult: string | PublicTypes.ParseResult, compileOpts: CompileOptions?): CompileResult`](src/Compiler.luau#L4246): Compiles Luau source code and returns a structured result with bytecode, diagnostics, and builder state.
- [`Compiler.compileProto(sourceOrParseResult: string | PublicTypes.ParseResult, compileOpts: CompileOptions?): (PublicTypes.ProtoModule?, string?)`](src/Compiler.luau#L4247): Compiles Luau source code or a parsed AST directly into an in-memory `ProtoModule` without binary serialization.

## Ouro.Profiles

- [Profiles](src/Profiles.luau): Named parser grammar flag profiles (`upstream`, `studio`, `experimental`) pinned to Luau 0.748.
- [`Profiles.named: { [string]: Types.ResolvedFlags }`](src/Profiles.luau#L27): [Read Only] Frozen map of built-in parser profiles keyed by name (`"upstream"`, `"studio"`, `"experimental"`).
- [`Profiles.resolve(value: (string | Types.GrammarFlags)?): Types.ResolvedFlags`](src/Profiles.luau#L31-L47): Resolves a built-in profile name or validates a custom `GrammarFlags` table against upstream defaults.

## Ouro.VM

- [VM](src/VM/init.luau): Pure-Luau Luau 0.748 register VM with isolated environments, execution budgets, and debug hooks.
- [`type Proto = Types.Proto`](src/VM/init.luau#L11)
- [`type ProtoModule = Types.ProtoModule`](src/VM/init.luau#L12)
- [`type CompileOptions = Types.CompileOptions`](src/VM/init.luau#L13)
- [`type BytecodeDecoder = Types.BytecodeDecoder`](src/VM/init.luau#L14)
- [`type LoadMode = Types.LoadMode`](src/VM/init.luau#L15)
- [`type LoadOptions = Types.LoadOptions`](src/VM/init.luau#L16)
- [`type EnvironmentOptions = Types.EnvironmentOptions`](src/VM/init.luau#L17)
- [`type ResourceLimits = Types.ResourceLimits`](src/VM/init.luau#L18)
- [`type DebugFrameInfo = Types.DebugFrameInfo`](src/VM/init.luau#L19)
- [`type CoverageEntry = Types.CoverageEntry`](src/VM/init.luau#L20)
- [`type UpvalueInfo = Types.UpvalueInfo`](src/VM/init.luau#L21)
- [`VM.createEnvironment`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Builds an isolated VM global environment table with pure Luau standard libraries or optional host fallbacks.
- [`VM.sandbox`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Creates a writable per-chunk overlay table backed read-only by `baseEnv` with isolated RNG state.
- [`VM.traceback`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Formats a guest VM stack trace matching upstream `luaL_traceback`.
- [`VM.getCoverage`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Returns per-proto line execution counts for closures compiled with `coverageLevel` `1` or `2`.
- [`VM.cloneFunction`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Clones a VM closure sharing upvalue references with optional new environment and load overrides.
- [`VM.getUpvalues`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Inspects captured upvalues (`1`-based) on a VM closure.
- [`VM.setUpvalue`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Mutates an open or closed upvalue slot (`1`-based) on a VM closure.
- [`VM.resetBudget`](src/VM/init.luau#L1): [Re-export] Resets the instruction counter and clears the lazy `timeout` timer for the module context owning `fn`.
- [`VM.load(chunk: string | buffer | ProtoModule, options: LoadOptions?): (((...any) -> ...any)?, string?)`](src/VM/init.luau#L457): Compiles or deserializes a Luau chunk (source, binary bytecode, or `ProtoModule`) into a callable sandboxed closure.
- [`VM.loadBytecode(bytecode: string | buffer, options: LoadOptions?): (((...any) -> ...any)?, string?)`](src/VM/init.luau#L459): Deserializes binary Luau bytecode (`string` or `buffer`) and loads it into a callable closure without invoking the compiler.
- [`VM.loadProto(protoModule: ProtoModule, options: LoadOptions?): (((...any) -> ...any)?, string?)`](src/VM/init.luau#L461): Validates and instantiates a callable closure from an in-memory `ProtoModule`.
